title: Pentaryn Prompt Markers
description: Drop a prompt marker on a map, type what should be there, press Esc. Six hidden marker actors (tiny to xxl, in the 'Prompt Markers' folder) carry a few words each; a side panel shows what the marker can see through the walls, nearest first. One gather call hands Claude every prompt with distances, bands, bearings, line of sight, encounters and loners; one replace call puts the real thing on the marker's footprint, stamps the prompt on it as provenance and removes the marker. Exposes game.pentaryn.prompts and the pentaryn-prompts.* queries (GM only).

recommends.reason: Wraps Token#_onClickLeft2 so double-clicking a prompt marker opens its text; without it the method is wrapped by hand.
Hotspot replacements clone the 'Hotspot · Look (template)' Item Piles container.
